topic: Massage for cyclists: quads, hips and calves

slides.headline: Quads, hips and calves feeling cooked?
slides.sub: Where remedial massage fits into a cyclist's recovery.

slides.title: Where riders get tight
slides.body: Hours of pedalling load the quads, hip flexors, glutes and calves. Many riders notice tightness at the front of the hips and thighs after a big week.

slides.title: Quads and hip flexors
slides.body: Massage to the front of the thigh and hip can ease that tight, heavy feeling and make getting off the bike and standing tall feel more comfortable.

slides.title: Glutes and outer hip
slides.body: Your therapist may work the glutes and the tissue along the outside of the thigh. It can feel tender, so let them know if the pressure is too much.

slides.title: Calves after climbing
slides.body: Calf work can help your lower legs feel less tight after hilly rides. Keep things lighter the day before a big event, and save deeper work for recovery days.

slides.title: One part of your recovery
slides.body: Massage complements rest, sleep, sensible training load and strength work. It can help you feel better between rides, but it doesn't replace the rest of your recovery.

slides.headline: Book a rider's recovery massage
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists tailor each session to your riding and training week. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Big week on the bike? Quads, hips and calves feeling cooked?

Pedalling for hours loads the front of the thighs, the hip flexors, glutes and calves. Remedial massage can ease that tight, heavy feeling and help you move more comfortably between rides. Keep things lighter the day before an event and save deeper work for recovery days.

Massage works well alongside rest, sleep, sensible training load and strength work, rather than replacing them.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy can tailor a session to your riding week. Book online via the link in bio.

story.headline: Legs cooked after the ride?
story.body: A recovery massage can help. Save the deeper work for a day with no big ride planned.
